source: Grok 4.6 Expert at grok.com, review round 2, returned 2026-09-08. Six fixtures; three run here, one is on the orchestration plane and two on the persistence plane (evals/cases/deferred/).
notes: Review-round-2 fixtures, ingested 2026-09-10. Every text is the reviewer's, verbatim. Where the reviewer's expectation was written in their own vocabulary rather than the runner's, expect carries the projection and original_expect keeps the reviewer's words; where a session block or a prior turn could not be carried as written, reviewer_session or reviewer_prior_turns keeps the original and projection_note says what was done. pass as written means the reviewer's expectation, projected without a change of meaning, passes; contract_adjusted means the meaning moved and adjust_note says why; disputed and known_gap run as strict expected failures. Names in the reviewers' files are the earlier names (calder, ravi, sera, ellie); the alias layer resolves them.

cases.text: my sibling relapsed yesterday, help me plan a calm conversation that does not shame them
cases.why: D3's second half. Today the tree seats recovery. Until this fixture is the Accepted expectation, three documents disagree about a hard turn.
cases.projection_note: The reviewer's agent 'conflict_or_strategist_not_recovery' is projected as agent_any_of over the conflict persona and the strategist with the recovery persona pinned out of seat and assist; the outcome 'seat_is_ask_not_recovery' is the same claim. Built 10 September (ADR-0027 (Proposed), Proposed): this fixture is now the Accepted expectation the reviewer asked for, and the three documents that disagreed say one thing.

cases.text: a parent relapsed last month and nobody at home will talk about it

expect.reason_contains: hold on addiction_recovery carried by the seat

cases.why: D3's first half. grok-seat-004 stays a dissent fixture because it expects a hold and not this seat.
cases.projection_note: The reviewer's agent 'recovery' is the recovery persona (calder, now cody); the outcome 'recovery_seated_as_hold_specialist' is asserted through the record's reason. grok-seat-004 no longer stays a dissent fixture: under the built rule it passes and is marked resolved with its history kept (review round 2, ChatGPT 2.10).

cases.text: I relapsed last night and I need a plan for tomorrow morning
cases.why: A humor persona vetoed on recovery must not arrive as hold-source assist. Round-1 leak fixtures are affinity-source; this pins the new source.
cases.adjust_note: A first-person return to use claims the seat (ADR-0016); the record carries it as seat_claim with claim_subject self, not as a hold, so the reviewer's held: [addiction_recovery] named the right domain in the wrong vocabulary and is not asserted. The reviewer's declared_affinity 'humor_persona' is the humour persona, Nikki, carried as the contract's affinities field; assist_source is not a fixture field because the assist from the hold (ADR-0025 (Proposed)) is unbuilt, so today no assist arrives from any source. The leak the reviewer pins, the vetoed humour persona arriving as assist, is asserted as not_seated, which covers seat and assist.
